answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the lotus is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the crystal of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the cedar behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal cimfq.
